name: Mighty Mach One
description: Symbolized by the griffin and the Maltese Cross, representing strength, vigilance, and a long tradition of honor.

name: Deuce
description: Represented by red, white, and blue contrails streaking toward space, symbolizing speed, patriotism, and the reach beyond the atmosphere.

name: Dogs of War
description: Embodied by Cerberus and flames, symbolizing ferocity, guardianship, and relentless fighting spirit.

name: Fightin' Fourth
description: Represented by a prop and wings alongside four classes united, symbolizing aviation heritage and squadron unity across all four years.

name: Wolfpack
description: Symbolized by a snarling wolf and the rallying cry 'Feed 'em to the wolves!', representing pack mentality and fierce competitiveness.

name: Bull Six
description: Represented by a black bull set against a red background, symbolizing raw power, aggression, and intimidation.

name: Shadow Seven
description: Symbolized by a unicorn and a lightning bolt, representing mystique, rarity, and swift, unstoppable striking power.

name: Eagle Eight
description: Represented by the F-15 Eagle and four class stars, symbolizing air superiority and the collective achievement of every class.

name: Viking Nine
description: Symbolized by dragon ships, representing boldness, exploration, and a fearless warrior spirit.

name: Tiger Ten
description: Represented by the Flying Tigers and lightning bolts, symbolizing aggression, speed, and a storied legacy of combat excellence.
